sn41.2:2.2: The term of address “Honorable Senior” (_bhante thera_) is found only in this sutta and the next two. Note that when _bhante therā_ is used above, the plural _therā_ is nominative, whereas here the singular _thera_ is vocative.
sn41.2:2.4: “The venerable senior” (_āyasmā thero_) is found only in this sutta and the next.
